name: Foxdale Guesthouse & Campsite
accommodation: Four B&B rooms and 30 grass camping pitches (15 with hook-up)
dogs: Up to two dogs per pitch on the campsite
beachAccess: Not stated; edge of Marloes village, close to Marloes Sands
confirmedFeatures: Cooked or continental breakfast, Wi-Fi, free showers, dishwashing area, electric hook-ups
overview: Foxdale is a family-run guesthouse and campsite on Glebe Lane at the edge of Marloes village. It has four B&B rooms and a 30-pitch campsite, and the pub and shop are within walking distance.
surfTripFit: Close to Marloes Sands, with both rooms and pitches so groups can split budgets.
